artifact: 60_synth portfolio decision package (final 24 + top 10, P4-P6 integrated)

items.concept: Reel-to-reel contactless REBCO tape quality metrology (Hall-array critical-current mapping + delamination screening) sold to tape vendors and magnet builders as certified acceptance instrumentation.
items.why_now: REBCO tape volume is contract-dated to triple-to-10x into the early 2030s (Shanghai Superconductor RMB1.6B HL-4; Furukawa-Tokamak deal) while acceptance QC remains captive or conflicted — the neutral instrument arrives exactly at the volume ramp.
items.key_kill: Tape vendors' own TapeStar data accepted as-is by magnet builders, or THEVA adding the delamination/thermal channel first.

items.concept: 800-VDC rack power-path protection: integrated solid-state breaker + precharge/inrush control + insulation monitoring + hot-swap sequencing unit for AI racks and power sidecars
items.why_now: The 800VDC generation ships 2027 with the platform owner itself naming protection and serviceability as the open gap, and China's buyer-side forum admits no 800V safety-certification regime exists — the certified merchant protection layer is being decided now.
items.key_kill: NVIDIA/OCP spec absorption: a reference protection design shipped integrated by shelf vendors (DG Matrix-class) before this venture's UL/IEC path completes.

items.concept: Standards-grade thermal emulation and conformance metrology: programmable multi-kW chip-scale thermal test vehicles and rack-scale load emulators for liquid-cooling qualification
items.why_now: Eight vendors already build to a buyer-authored 2MW CDU spec with no independent conformance method, and fresh verification confirms OCP still publishes only guidelines — the method-authority seat is open at the exact moment warranty and PUE stakes force third-party-grade qualification.
items.key_kill: OCP publishing a complete qualification methodology with reference hardware before the venture's method becomes the industry habit.

items.concept: Coherent-beam-combining phase-control engine: a channel-scalable electro-optic 'conductor' (controller ASIC/FPGA + modulator front-ends) sold to directed-energy primes and ultrafast-laser OEMs.
items.why_now: JLWS awards are executed, beam-control has its own budgeted Navy line item awarding from Q4-2026, and coherent combining is the only path to 300-500kW — the control layer is being procured now with no merchant vendor in existence.
items.key_kill: Primes classifying and internalizing beam control, with JBCS awards carrying no subsystem carve-out.

items.concept: Multi-terminal DC fault-discrimination protection relay plus vendor-neutral hardware-in-the-loop qualification platform for MVDC datacenter distribution and HVDC converter stations - the 'SEL of DC grids.'
items.why_now: Three independent US HVDC developers hold committed capital ($2.6B+$1.7B contractor awards+a four-project pipeline) under a FERC interregional mandate, and no vendor-neutral DC protection or qualification authority exists as multi-terminal designs reach construction.
items.key_kill: US DC staying point-to-point with protection bundled inside converter-vendor stations through 2034.

items.concept: 300C-class mixed-signal instrumentation electronics platform (SiC/SOI) for superhot geothermal, downhole, and turbine environments
items.why_now: Three oilfield-service majors committed capital to superhot/EGS projects targeting 2030 operation while the only merchant HT mixed-signal line closed — buyers face a live sourcing gap between purchasable (225C) and required (300C+).
items.key_kill: Superhot drilling slipping past 2030, or Ozark/in-house oilfield teams capturing the instrumentation sockets first.

items.concept: Merchant quench-detection-and-protection subsystem for REBCO/HTS magnets: co-wound distributed fiber-optic sensing plus sub-millisecond active energy extraction, sold with a qualification dossier to fusion companies and national labs.
items.why_now: A merchant HTS magnet market now exists (CFS selling to Realta/WHAM) with SPARC results converting to pilot-plant builds ~2030, and every multi-megajoule REBCO coil still lacks purchasable quench protection — qualification data built 2027-2029 becomes the moat at exactly the procurement moment.
items.key_kill: No-insulation windings proving sufficient at pilot scale, or CFS open-sourcing an in-house protection standard.

items.concept: Vendor-neutral ion-energy-distribution metrology + tailored-waveform bias control retrofit for plasma etch chambers
items.why_now: Waveform-capable generators are ramping into CHIPS-funded sub-2nm fabs whose engineers are publicly 'tuning blind', and fresh verification confirms no closed-loop IEDF product exists anywhere — the measurement-to-control step is unclaimed.
items.key_kill: Generator vendors shipping good-enough integrated IEDF inference, or OEM chamber-data lockdown; CN leg dies unless rebuilt off Entity-Listed customers.

items.concept: Precision GaN pump-driver and laser-power modules: nanosecond-class programmable current drive as a merchant subsystem for industrial and defense-adjacent laser OEMs
items.why_now: nLIGHT's executed JLWS ceiling and record A&D growth prove the US drive-electronics pull while China's fiber-laser price war forces cost-down outsourcing — both legs need the qualified driver layer OEMs under-invest in.
items.key_kill: OEM NIH culture holding (fewer than two paid evaluations by 2028 folds it into D-10); Raycus replacement counterparty not secured.

items.concept: Solid-state microsecond impedance-matching engines (switched SiC/PIN capacitor arrays replacing motorized vacuum-capacitor matchboxes) for pulsed and tailored-waveform RF plasma tools
items.why_now: Comet's flagship match remains electromechanical at <500ms on its own datasheet while pulsed/TVW processes tune in microseconds — a four-order-of-magnitude re-match gap sits under every advanced plasma tool with no merchant solid-state matcher shipping.
items.key_kill: AE/MKS integrating solid-state matching as a platform feature before a merchant design win; CN chapter dies unless restructured off the HK scheme and Entity-Listed buyers.

items.concept: US merchant NEG-coating and low-outgassing surface engineering line for UHV/XHV chambers (accelerators, quantum, EUV, space simulation)
items.why_now: EIC long-lead procurement is approved, PIP-II completes 2028, and the QIS renewal is funded while the world's only merchant NEG-coating line remains a single Italian plant — US programs are buying into a sole-source bottleneck now.
items.key_kill: SAES announcing US coating capacity, or accelerator budgets stalling the procurement wave.

items.concept: Standardized solid-state pulsed-power platform: stackable Marx/modulator modules with digital droop control for industrial e-beam, X-ray, and accelerator RF drive
items.why_now: Cargo-scanning and isotope-accelerator procurement is dated and growing on both legs while the incumbent (ScandiNova) verifiably moves toward MORE proprietary integration — the interoperable-module position stands vacant as demand compounds.
items.key_kill: Beam-system OEMs refusing external drive chains (no design-in by 2033).

items.concept: Electrolyzer stack degradation-emulation and bankability test systems: programmable ripple/intermittency benches that turn stack warranties into measurable engineering
items.why_now: Stack warranties are still written ahead of degradation knowledge with ~$5B of surviving hub cost-share and CN mega-tenders needing acceptance testing, and fresh verification confirms the incumbent bench vendor offers no ripple synthesis — the qualification-authority seat is open on either industry branch.
items.key_kill: Hydrogen FIDs collapsing on both legs, or Greenlight adding stress-synthesis to its installed platform first.

items.concept: Thermal-shock-tolerant printed-circuit heat exchangers (PCHE): merchant diffusion-bonded recuperators for sCO2 power, heat pumps, and hydrogen precooling
items.why_now: NRC Part 53 is in force, STEP runs at supercritical conditions, and China's first commercial sCO2 waste-heat plant is generating revenue — the recuperator is the cost-dominant choke-point and no vendor publishes rapid-transient qualification.
items.key_kill: No >=10MW-class merchant sCO2 order by end-2033, or Heatric/VPE publishing transient-qualified lines first.

items.concept: DC-conversion acceptance and commissioning instrumentation: a portable measurement island (swept-impedance bus-stability analyzer, IT-network insulation/ground-fault characterization, hot-swap/inrush transient capture) plus standardized acceptance protocols and signed dossiers, for facilities converting legacy UPS power rooms to 240V/336V/+-400V/800VDC and for vendors qualifying DC shelves - the measurement layer of the DC transition, not another in-path power product.
items.why_now: The DC transition is architecturally unconverged with buyers converting live halls, and fresh verification across Chroma/Keysight/Hioki confirms no system-level 800VDC acceptance solution exists — commissioning heterogeneity is the product's raw material and it is compounding.
items.key_kill: Operators accepting vendor self-certification (no frame agreement by 2029), or instrument majors shipping DC acceptance suites first.

items.concept: High-density cryogenic interconnect loader with co-packaged 4K readout front-end (superconducting flex harness + cryo-CMOS multiplexing + cryo-LNA), breaking the 256-channel-per-loader wall for quantum computers.
items.why_now: The renewed $625M QIS program and >1,000-qubit roadmaps collide with dilution-fridge heat budgets that passive cabling cannot solve — with Delft/Bluefors shipping passive density, the co-packaged 4K electronics layer is the remaining unclaimed bottleneck.
items.key_kill: Delft/Bluefors adding cold multiplexing to their integrated stack, or modular chip-to-chip links becoming the scaling norm.

items.concept: Charge-buildup-immune beam current and dose metrology for ultra-high-dose-rate (FLASH) and industrial electron beams -- the traceable ammeter the field admits it lacks.
items.why_now: Two independent 2025 papers document that standard beam-current transformers fail at FLASH dose rates while NCI has already bought this capability class through a contract vehicle — the traceability wall arrives with clinical qualification 2028-2032.
items.key_kill: FLASH clinical stall plus PTW converting its research detector into a traceable commercial reference first.

items.concept: Modular plasma destruction units for concentrated PFAS waste streams (spent AFFF, IX regenerant, membrane reject) for DoD and water utilities
items.why_now: The AFFF statutory deadline lands 2026-10 and DoD's demonstration program carries a sole-source Success-Memo pathway into ~700-site remediation procurement — paid plasma destruction precedent exists and the modality race is still open.
items.key_kill: A Success Memo crowning SCWO for concentrated streams before the plasma demonstration completes, or energy economics missing 50 kWh/kg.

items.concept: PFAS-free pumped two-phase direct-to-chip cooling loop: hermetic, fluid-agnostic evaporator/condenser subsystem co-qualified with low-GWP non-PFAS working fluids
items.why_now: Enacted law (AIM Act allowance step-down 2029; EU F-gas 2030 ban) collides with 3-5kW chips exactly at launch while no vendor claims a PFAS-free qualification dataset — though the HFO path (Opteon 2P50) is now filling part of the vacuum, sharpening the non-fluorinated wedge.
items.key_kill: No non-PFAS two-phase fluid reaching datacenter-scale qualification by 2031, or single-phase water stretching another chip generation.

items.concept: Distributed composite-flywheel kinetic buffers for off-grid AI power plants: containerized magnetic-bearing flywheel strings that absorb GPU-cluster power swings so gas turbines and grids see smooth load.
items.why_now: A named 400MW off-grid AI plant already procured flywheel stabilization and the electrification order wave is running at $2.4B/quarter — kinetic buffering is procurable today with a DC-native, microcycle-optimized entrant slot still open.
items.key_kill: The measured load-spectrum study showing rack-level smoothing suffices, or BESS cycle costs closing the kinetic niche.

items.concept: Inline-metrology plasma surface-treatment machines for PCB and advanced-packaging substrates: atmospheric/vacuum plasma cleaning with closed-loop surface-energy and residue metrology
items.why_now: Two independent CN buyers ran plasma-cleaner tenders within three months on open international bidding, and no incumbent ships closed-loop treat-to-spec — the premium metrology tier is unclaimed in a live, recurring procurement category.
items.key_kill: No paid premium-commitment beta by 2028, or ACM/Nordson fast-following once the category is proven.

items.concept: In-service coolant-health monitoring and side-stream conditioning skids for liquid-cooled AI-datacenter fleets (chemistry, particulates, bio-fouling, wear-metal telemetry with automated correction)
items.why_now: The 2024-2028 liquid-cooling cohort reaches fluid mid-life exactly at 2030 under spec regimes that define installation but not operations — and the incumbent itself confirms no standard exists for CDU failure handling.
items.key_kill: CDU vendors bundling coolant-health services into warranties before a merchant skid lands its first fleet.

items.concept: PEM electrolyzer 'protective operating envelope' controllers with warranty-grade black-box logging: embedded plant hardware that shapes current/OCV stress and produces bankable degradation evidence
items.why_now: Degradation-ignorant warranties are priced into ~$5B of surviving hub debt and underperforming CN parks face retrofit audits — envelope-enforcement hardware with notarized evidence converts that friction into a purchasable de-risking layer.
items.key_kill: The 2,000h A/B showing no measurable degradation-rate reduction, or lenders accepting OEM warranties without third-party evidence.

items.concept: Merchant 100 kWe-class space closed-Brayton power conversion unit and high-voltage PMAD for fission surface power -- the converter layer for the reactor decade.
items.why_now: NSTM-3 directs a funded, multivendor >=100kWe-scalable fission surface power program with the solicitation opening now — the converter layer every team currently rebuilds captive is the merchant position, held as a cheap option until the ~April-2027 downselect.
items.key_kill: Downselect passing without written subcontract interest from two teams, or program slip past 2034 leaving studies only.
